🛡️  ISLAND ELEPHANT Warranty and After sales Service

At ISLAND ELEPHANT, we are committed to providing high-quality products and reliable after-sales support.

✅  1-year official warranty (effective from the date of receipt of the order)
Warranty coverage:
Manufacturing defects under normal daily use
Zipper, hardware, stitching, shoulder straps, and other non-human quality issues
The warranty does not include:
① Man made damage, sharp objects scratching, heavy objects squeezing and deforming, unauthorized cutting and modification of bags;
② Long term exposure to rain and sun, improper washing can cause fabric fading, aging, and unraveling;
③ Minor daily wear and tear, slight fabric wrinkles, and minor oxidation scratches on hardware under normal use are not considered quality issues and are not covered by the warranty;

💬  Do you need warranty service? Just contact our customer service at any time during the 1-year warranty period and provide your order number and product photos. We will provide fast and professional solutions.

📦 Kind reminder: Please open the box and inspect the package on the spot when signing for it. If you find any problems such as product damage or missing items, please contact customer service as soon as possible and provide the shipping label and photos of the damaged product. We will quickly and properly handle the after-sales issues for you.

Thank you for choosing ISLAND ELEPHANT. We are committed to making every purchase worry free.   ❤️
